# R Markdown
R Markdown is a tool that allows you to combine text, code, and output into a single document. It supports research by keeping your analysis and explanation together.

This document shows how Markdown text, R code, and mathematical equations can be integrated. It makes reports easier to read and create compared to traditional methods.


# Inline Math Equation and Displayed Equation

$\theta = \frac{d}{t}$

$$
y=mx+b
$$

```{r}
data(mtcars)
summary(mtcars)

plot(mtcars$mpg, mtcars$hp,
     main = "MPG vs Horsepower",
     xlab = "Miles Per Gallon",
     ylab = "Horsepower")
```
